## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private keys are included
- [ ] No scanned code is executed, built, or deployed
- [ ] No new network access is introduced by default
- [ ] The scanned repository is still treated as untrusted input
- [ ] New dependencies (if any) are justified
